title: Otori Emu — Our Feelings Become One〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The chief director for this operation will be the Wonder Stage's own Rui Kamishiro! The singing and dancing will be led by Sakurako Seiryuin of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regarding anything else, feel free to ask me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's get this show on the road!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Nope♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm super duper happy that everybody at Phoenix Wonderland wants to help us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We need to do everything we can too then.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! So let's start by...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Emu!
We're about to begin practicing. Mind helping us out a bit?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: Sorry, there's something we thought that we should discuss first...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you know them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. They've all been doing shows here since when grandpa was still around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea...
S-So what is it that you'd like to discuss with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: It's that... We're sorry, Emu!!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: We felt the need to apologize to you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: Your grandfather took the time to always look after us, but we ended up making you have to do all of this...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: We didn't like the way this park was changing and knew that everyone else felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: But we just hid behind how it was just being what the higher ups decided and not knowing how else to get more guests into this park...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: Right. That includes the time when we heard about what would happen to the Wonder Stage. Even though we knew how much your grandfather loved it...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: Then, just after everyone from the Wonder Stage came to talk to us, Poochie was right behind them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean Mr. Mascot...?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yes. He told us that you, Emu, decided to fight back against what your family was doing for the sake of Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: Not only were you fighting these changes, you were coming up with other ways of saving this park...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: And that's why we're here now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: We feel ashamed of not acting sooner...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: But we still want to do everything we can to save the Phoenix Wonderland we know and love!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: Please, Emu! Give us another chance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You guys...!
*Sob*...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Buck up, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
We'll be happy to have you!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make this show the biggest, bestest thing ever, and show my brothers and my dad exactly how we feel!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And let's make it so that everyone who comes and visits go home with extra big smiles!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm not the only one that doesn't want this park to change. It felt like I was just being selfish for the longest time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm so glad that I'm not alone.
I'm so glad they feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I didn't give up either. I'm glad I asked you guys you help me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Again, me too!
Let's make sure this show succeeds!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It's gonna be a really, really extra huge success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I hope you're watching, grandpa!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Our Smiling Spell is gonna be so amazing!)
